name: Gustav
source: A priest with an easygoing attitude, Gustav is the guardian of the port city of Pharos. He greets his disciples warmly, though he can be serious when the situation calls for it. In battle, he takes to the front lines with his fists as well as a powerful assortment of ice magic.
